messages:
anna: pushed a follow-up to handle the config edge case + added tests. reduced allocation when queueing concurrent requests. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2478 PTAL when you have a sec. I ran the smoke locally and pushed fixes to the test harness.

jeff: taking a look now. can you add a short note in the changelog about the queue limit behaviour?

anna: added a one-liner in CHANGES.md and a unit test that asserts the soft-limit fallback. also included the smoke command in the PR description:

```bash
./devtools/run_smoke.sh --pr 2478 --replicas 2
```

rohan: CI reported flakes on the kvcache test last run but deploy-bot shows green now.

deploy-bot: CI status: all checks passed ✅ (build 5123) — integration, unit, lint.

jeff: :eyes: LGTM modulo one tiny nit (variable name). i'll drop an approve once that's fixed.

anna: fixed the variable name, pushed. re-requesting review. PTAL @jeff @rohan :rocket:

jeff: approved. scheduling merge for next canary slot (tomorrow 09:00 PT).
